verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents datasets as reusable test-case sets and supports running experiments on them programmatically via the SDK (`run_experiment`) and in CI/CD with a GitHub Action. A CLI for coding agents, an MCP server, SDK/API querying and a Metrics API for score metrics give an agent a path to read results back. missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating datasets via API/SDK/agent tooling, confirmation that the CLI/MCP tools cover dataset and experiment operations, clear docs on retrieving per-run experiment results programmatically, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven end-to-end flow.
